extracted_by: Extracted at build time by Claude from the transcript text (the same job llm.extract_guidance does with a key), then checked against the next calls and the reported quarterly numbers. Cached per ticker per quarter.

items.quote: Based on this visibility and the opportunities we are pursuing, we expect the group order inflows to grow in the range of 10% to 12% in FY27.
items.actual: Up 14% year on year in Q1 FY27
items.why: Q1 order inflows grew 14%, and management said in July it remained on track for the range.
items.actual_quote: Reflecting this momentum, the group order inflows at Rs. 1,080 billion, registered a 14% Y-on-Y growth.

items.quote: On Revenue, we expect growth to be in the range of 10% to 12% for FY27.
items.why: Filed results show first-half revenue of Rs 1,46,692 crore, up 11.4% on Rs 1,31,663 crore a year earlier, inside the range.

note: No transcript of the October 2026 call is on file, so H1 revenue comes from the filed quarterly results.
